# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{id}

Delete a release (keeps the git tag, deletes attachments from storage)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (write:repository scope) · **ID:** `ep-245`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Release not found or is tag-only
- **422** — Tag is protected and user not allowed to delete

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.DeleteRelease | controller | Get release by ID; Call DeleteReleaseByID with delTag=false |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | release_service.DeleteReleaseByID | service ⚡ | Set IsTag=true and update release (keeps tag); Load attributes; Delete attachments from DB; Delete attachment files from storage; Notify DeleteRelease |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Tag-only records (IsTag=true) are treated as non-existent releases and return 404 | validation | release.IsTag == true |
| Protected tag names prevent release creation and deletion | authorization | Tag matches protected tag pattern AND user not in allowlist |
| Deleting a release with delTag=false converts it back to a tag-only record instead of removing it | business_logic | delTag == false |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tag is protected and user not allowed | 422 | user not allowed to delete protected tag | False |

### Error Paths

- **Release not found or is tag-only** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Protected tag name** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Service error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
